newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms buy rapemeal, wheatbran pellet.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms buy rapemeal, wheatbran pellet.

text.p: A group of South Korean feed milling companies, known as the Feed Buying Group, bought on Tuesday 12,000 tonnes of Indian rapeseed meal at $141.95 a tonne C&F and 14,500 tonnes at $141.60 a tonne C&F from Nidera, traders said.
The Feed Buying Group also bought 36,000 tonnes of Indonesian wheatbran pellet at 129.20 won per kilogramme C&F from Bogasari, they said.
They said the rapeseed meal purchases were split into two positions -- one for 12,000 tonnes for arrival by May 20 and the other for 14,500 tonnes for arrival by June 20.
The wheatbran pellet purchases were also divided into two positions -- one for 18,000 tonnes for arrival by May 20 and the remaining of 18,000 tonnes for arrival by June 20.
Arrival was set to the port of Inchon.
